item.text: The fault is localized: the shared sorter currently ranks unpinned notes ahead of pinned ones, and the generic update path also refreshes `updatedAt` during a pin toggle. I’m checking the persisted-store merge behavior so the fix preserves the target’s timestamp and survives reload without disturbing unrelated records.

The focused fix is in place: pinned records now sort ahead of unpinned records, and a pin-only update retains the note’s original `updatedAt`, allowing the target to re-enter the unpinned group by its existing timestamp. I’m validating both compilation and the live interaction/reload path now.
